project.title: Microbial diversity under the influence of microplastics in A/A/O leachate biological treatment system.
project.description: Microbial diversity under the influence of microplastics in A/A/O leachate biological treatment system. To explore the microbial structure succession process under the influence of polyethylene and polystyrene microplastics, and the potential degradation dominant bacteria of microplastics.
